title: Braised Greek Turnip Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew perfect for a cold winter's night. This Greek-inspired dish combines tender turnips with the rich flavors of braised meat and warm spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the turnips, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth and red wine. Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 30-40 minutes, or until the turnips are tender.
Stir in the lemon juice and serve hot.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice, if desired.
